content.text:
The university wants uni_owns_nonexclusive_licence instead of contract_research_company_owns. This is a meaningful change - we lose ownership of results. However, a non-exclusive licence still lets us use results commercially. The key concern is competitors could also get a licence. 

I should counter: accept the IP change but push for exclusivity upgrade or longer exclusivity to compensate. I can change IP to uni_owns_nonexclusive_licence (concede) and extend exclusivity months or make it exclusive licence. Actually the schema only has non-exclusive licence as an option under uni_owns...

Let me trade: accept uni_owns_nonexclusive_licence but increase exclusivity months to 24 to ensure competitors can't access findings for longer.
